headline: Microsoft Research’s Quine links biological models, tools, literature, and scientists in one research harness

verified_story_context.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Quine as an early-stage research effort to build a multimodal world model of biology together with an interactive harness connecting models, scientific tools, literature, and researchers. A Quine Fellows program is intended to give scientists access to the system and generate scientific feedback from real research use.
verified_story_context.why_it_matters: Complex research domains may benefit more from systems that coordinate representations, external tools, literature, and expert feedback than from asking one model to answer every question from internal knowledge.

visual.layout: professional mechanism-rich textbook architecture diagram with a central biological world-model hub and explicit bidirectional connections
visual.mechanism: A central biological world model connects scientific literature, scientific tools, multiple biological data modalities, and researcher feedback through an interactive research harness, with evidence and feedback cycling back into the model.
visual.alt_text: Professional textbook architecture diagram showing a central biological world model connected through an interactive research harness to scientific literature, scientific tools, multiple biological modalities, and researcher feedback.
visual.style: professional high-detail white-background textbook/editorial systems diagram; crisp scientific architecture; mechanism-first; no people, humanoid figures, cinematic scenes, stock-photo look, decorative biology imagery, dashboards, sparse generic cards, promotional headline prose, or overlapping text
required_elements: multiple biological data modalities such as sequence, imaging, molecular or experimental data
interactive research harness surrounding or connecting the components
researcher feedback/review node represented without a person
clear bidirectional evidence and feedback arrows
visual.text_policy: Use only short legible mechanism labels such as Biological world model, Literature, Scientific tools, Biological modalities, Research harness, Research feedback, Evidence loop. No promotional copy and no unsupported model-provider names.
